report.headline: Single five-minute price spike to 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: The five-minute RRP in the interval before the spike (interval ending 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z / 2026-08-06 12:55 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 41.58768 $/MWh (evidence ev0952).
At the spike (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z / 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) the five-minute RRP was 450.08 $/MWh (evidence ev0969).
In the interval straight after (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:05:00Z / 2026-08-06 13:05 AEST (UTC+1000)) the five-minute RRP was 47.701 $/MWh (evidence ev0972).
Only one five-minute interval met or exceeded the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window (intervals_at_or_above_threshold = 1; evidence ev0950; threshold evidence ev0951).

Operational demand (half-hour measure from get_actual_demand) in the half-hour containing the price extreme (peak_half_hour_end_utc 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1147.0 MW (evidence ev0893), and the window maximum operational demand was 1408.0 MW (evidence ev0905).
Net interconnector flow at the peak interval (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z / 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)) was 63.84 MW net flow out of TAS1 (evidence ev0957).
A public-document search returned no AEMO market notice held for TAS1 in the searched window (retrieve_public_evidence search_scope outcome: "no notice held for this region and window").

possible_explanations.statement: A short-lived generation trip or withdrawal might have occurred (SCADA unit changes were observed in the 00:00–06:00 UTC window).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit outage logs, plant trip records and detailed SCADA traces around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to confirm any instantaneous loss of capacity.

possible_explanations.statement: A transient constraint or dispatch constraint might have briefly tightened local supply and bids might have cleared at a high price.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review constraint and dispatch message logs with timestamps including 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (interval end) to see if any constraint became binding in that interval.
